# Artalk 2.10.1 vendor files

These files are copied from the official npm package so the comment client does
not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

- `Artalk.js`: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/artalk@2.10.1/dist/Artalk.js`
- `Artalk.css`: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/artalk@2.10.1/dist/Artalk.css`
- `LICENSE`: upstream MIT license
